source_documents.role: Historical unit-test evidence that identifies spill cleanup failure under umask 0002 and passing isolation under umask 0022.
Frozen quality criteria for deterministic unit-test and security-negative-control evidence.
Current implementation and focused fixture ownership.

findings.summary: The 9 failures under umask 0002 were caused by cleanup fixtures creating session-* directories with the process-default mode 0775. The shipped cleanup intentionally rejects group-writable session directories. The product writer already creates 0700 session directories and 0600 files. Declaring mode 0700 on trusted cleanup fixtures makes the same 41-test file pass under both umask 0002 and 0022, while the explicit unsafe-directory cases remain passing.
findings.limitations: This action covers the focused spill-local source-plane file only. It does not qualify the complete repository unit, coverage, snapshot, Web, or release matrices.

decision.test_change: Trusted session-directory fixtures now request mode 0700 explicitly; intentionally unsafe fixtures remain permissive or are chmodded unsafe.
decision.next_action: Complete AAA-004 and move to the next dependency-free backlog action after updating the current report pointer.

validation.validation_method: Parse commands.jsonl; require unique command IDs, existing raw-output files with matching SHA-256, non-empty source_refs, and a PASS after-fix run under both umask values plus the unsafe-directory negative control.
